findings.note: Real and deliberate. hc/settings.py:70 is `DEBUG = envbool("DEBUG", "True")`, so a deployment that does not set the DEBUG environment variable runs with DEBUG on. Healthchecks knows this: its own production checklist in README.md tells operators to 'make sure it is set to False'. Convenient for local development, a hazard for anyone who deploys without reading the checklist, which is exactly what this rule is for. Reported at tentative because the environment can override it.
